name: Sinopterus
sum: Toothless, crested tapejarid from the Jiufotang Formation of Liaoning, China — the first pterosaur with direct evidence of plant-eating.
wsnote: Holotype about 1.2 m; maximum adult about 1.9 m (2.87 kg).
holotype: IVPP V13363 (S. dongi) — Jiufotang Formation, Chaoyang, Liaoning.
material: Numerous specimens at various growth stages; several former species now synonymised with S. dongi.
exceptional: Gut contents with gastroliths and plant phytoliths (grasses, gymnosperms or ferns).
biology: Herbivore with a gizzard similar to that of the bird Jeholornis; growth series documents crest development.
author: Wang and Zhou 2002
